question: When was Alluri Sitarama Raju arrested ending a two-year armed tribal struggle?
solution:
The correct answer is May __**1924**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 1924, Alluri was detained. He was publicly executed in Koyyuru on May 7 after being tied to a tree and shot.
 
• This effectively put an end to the armed uprising.
